references.text: The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands carefully, in accordance with the tradition of the elders.

The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they wash their hands up to the elbow, and they hold to the traditions of the elders. When they come from the marketplace, they do not eat without washing. And there are many other things they have taken upon themselves to observe, such as washing cups, pitchers, and bronze vessels.
So you shall keep my statutes and my rules, which I command you.
